title: Music Beneath the Radio Calls
tests: Tests whether added music remains audibly subordinate to the original speech, with intelligibility preserved throughout the delivered video.

got.question:
I can generate a tense instrumental bed, but the connected tools can’t mix it into your video or duck it beneath the radio calls while preserving the footage and dialogue.

How long is the clip? I can make a matching standalone track. For the final mix, keep it low beneath all speech, with extra ducking around **“Rook, you with me?”** so every word stays clear.

faults.what: The supplied output is a standalone WAV, not the original cockpit video with music added; it contains no clear radio dialogue.
The generated track lasts 15 seconds rather than matching the seven-second duration supplied by the user.

judge.summary: A 15-second standalone audio track was produced instead of a seven-second cockpit video with music beneath the preserved radio calls.

must_haves.item: The output preserves all seven seconds of the original cockpit footage without visual changes or extra shots.
must_haves.why: Only an audio output is supplied; the shown cockpit frame belongs to the user's input.

must_haves.item: A tense instrumental music bed is audible, with no added singing.
must_haves.why: The sound description indicates music or ambience with no clear speech, but does not establish whether the music sounds tense.

must_haves.item: The original radio calls remain present and synchronized, including the clearly intelligible line 'Rook, you with me?'
must_haves.why: The output transcription reports no clear speech, and no video mix is supplied.

must_haves.item: During every spoken line, the music is perceptibly below the voice and does not mask words with loud beats, swells, or accents.
must_haves.why: The required dialogue-and-music mix is absent; the standalone track does not demonstrate music beneath any radio calls.

must_haves.item: The music is not simply muted for the entire clip; it is audible while remaining subordinate to speech.
must_haves.why: Audio is present, but no preserved speech is present for it to remain subordinate to.
